caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A plain how-to headline promotes the verb animate inside a single lavender rough-display tag, with a short scope note immediately underneath.
visual_anatomy.layout: A four-by-four equal-cell catalogue pairs a terse motion instruction at the top of every pastel tile with a miniature moving specimen underneath.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title and scope note → scan tiles left-to-right, top-to-bottom → use each visual specimen to interpret the implementation note.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large editorial sans title, rough display emphasis, then small pragmatic instructions designed to fit within a regular grid.
visual_anatomy.colour: Sixteen soft lavender, pink, blue, aqua, and green tile grounds separate individual techniques without encoding a common data variable.
visual_anatomy.surface: Flat tile fields divided by white gutters, fine line drawings, small 2.5D shapes, translucent overlays, and restrained shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: Sixteen equal technique cells, each containing one instruction and one animated specimen.
visual_anatomy.density: Medium-high: a browsing catalogue rather than one continuous argument, made retrievable by repeated cell anatomy.

motion.observed_state_change: Across sampled frames, the miniatures independently demonstrate stacking, circle expansion or fading, crop-and-slide movement, colour appearance, shape morphing, bar growth, rotation, highlight passage, resizing, and a dot moving along a route.
motion.motion_job: Teach a catalogue of animation behaviours by showing each behaviour in the exact small visual context it changes.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Choose a motion behaviour based on an observable before-and-after, instead of a named effect alone.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Give every option an identical retrieval unit: a compact condition or method note plus a visibly changing miniature.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use a catalogue only when a reader needs to browse several valid techniques; for a single decision, show the one motion that explains the actual relationship.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the sixteen-technique selection, instruction wording, tile grid, miniatures, pastel palette, rough headline tag, source-tool reference, or any individual animation treatment.

claim_boundary.note: The asset demonstrates craft options, not evidence that any animation improves audience outcomes or is appropriate for every information object.
